rule: A control is ENFORCED only when an executable probe rejects the old behaviour. Otherwise it is UNCONTROLLED.

controls.failure: Optimising one commission instead of total capability
controls.uncontrolled_reason: No live gate yet requires a portfolio effect and successor mutation for every wave.
controls.next_control: Add wave acceptance schema and a negative fixture that contains a local result but no portfolio or successor effect.

controls.failure: Describing a loop, role or launch sheet as operating before provider execution
controls.fail_closed_mechanism: Operational runtime states require a provider locator and launch receipt; durable states additionally require commit, remote read-back and parent ingestion.

controls.failure: Substituting receipts, tests, schemas or automation activity for strategic learning or a changed operation
controls.uncontrolled_reason: The repository can validate evidence shape but the ChatGPT turn boundary does not yet enforce an operational effect or executable launch.
controls.next_control: Add a response/effect contract at the command layer and reject closure when changed_operation and launch_now are both empty.

controls.failure: Treating an arbitrary worker count or one route ceiling as effective/global scale
controls.uncontrolled_reason: Route-specific evidence exists, but no common telemetry contract is enforced across every parent/runtime.
controls.next_control: Require runtime, dispatch, isolation, time window, denominator, accepted throughput and recovery fields for every capacity claim.

controls.failure: Quietly allocating weaker models or lower reasoning
controls.uncontrolled_reason: Launch text requires exact strong models, but provider-side selection is not mechanically read back.
controls.next_control: Reject launch receipts lacking exact provider model/configuration and a paired evidence-backed exception for any downgrade.

controls.failure: Provider completion without a recoverable committed worker result
controls.uncontrolled_reason: Nine custody cycles were ingested, but result-ref fencing remains open and the bounded width-two route does not prove all writers or retries safe.
controls.next_control: Implement compare-and-swap result-ref ownership and prove fail-before/pass-after for post-ingestion ref advance, duplicate callback and stale writer.

controls.failure: Using the founder as routine relay, monitor, comparison or merge layer
controls.fail_closed_mechanism: Every founder action requires an allowlisted genuine provider/owner reason, bounded scope, exact instruction path and delegated parallel work; global-gate claims fail validation.

controls.failure: Engineering around a fast click, download, OAuth, approval or file action
controls.uncontrolled_reason: Exact actions are now surfaced, but no command-layer timer or provider-boundary detector forces immediate escalation.
controls.next_control: Add an owner-action SLA and fail a lane that remains blocked while an exact sub-five-minute owner route exists.

controls.failure: Treating producer narrative or provider completion as independent evidence
controls.uncontrolled_reason: Current evaluations separate states, but not every producer route is schema-gated and some historical rows remain self-reported.
controls.next_control: Reject acceptance unless reviewer identity differs from producer and immutable replay evidence plus frozen criteria are present.

controls.failure: Acknowledging a founder correction without changing affected prompts, routes, evaluations and successor packages
controls.uncontrolled_reason: This correction changed current packets and controls, but older estate prompts and default-branch pointers are not yet all reconciled.
controls.next_control: Require an effect graph and negative propagation test across every affected downstream surface before closure.

controls.failure: Silently serialising or deprioritising unaffected work
controls.fail_closed_mechanism: Control-plane validation requires every active lane to retain explicit state and permits no founder action with global or programme blocking scope.

controls.failure: Trapping strategy, state, prompts or logic in one vendor runtime
controls.uncontrolled_reason: Portable repository artifacts exist, but no complete substitute-runtime replay and cross-provider successor acceptance has passed.
controls.next_control: Run clean-clone and substitute-runtime replay with provider memory absent.

controls.failure: Converting a discovery recommendation into company strategy without founder binding
controls.fail_closed_mechanism: Every state, plan, control and event requires decision_changed empty; STRATEGY_DECISION events require founder-bound authority.

controls.failure: Multiple candidate controllers assume ownership of one shared branch or ledger
controls.uncontrolled_reason: The contract and bounded isolated route are validated, but the historical collision is durable, provider branch permissions do not mechanically enforce one writer and result-ref fencing is open.
controls.next_control: Enforce root-only credentials/fence, CAS result refs and fail-before/pass-after stale-writer tests before widening beyond two.

controls.failure: Publishing a control plane but leaving ready provider operations without a launch instruction
controls.uncontrolled_reason: Exact Cursor, SW and ChatGPT launches now exist, but the response runtime has no structural end-of-turn launch/effect gate.
controls.next_control: Add command-layer closure validation requiring changed live operation or executable launch plus evidence.

controls.failure: Running a full Work-mode reconciliation for every PR synchronize event
controls.fail_closed_mechanism: The event-triggered job is disabled; the enabled replacement is hourly, deduplicates a time window, permits at most one evidence decision/commit and writes nothing without material delta.

controls.failure: Eight parents rebuild the entire commission instead of dividing disjoint ownership
controls.uncontrolled_reason: The one-factory follow-ups are ready, but founder-authenticated Cursor threads have not yet received them and existing in-flight work remains provider-side.
controls.next_control: Send all eight follow-ups; require first new substantive commit to bind one disjoint domain and prohibit replacement whole-commission dispatch.

controls.failure: Founder directions remain only in chat, Library or voice threads
controls.uncontrolled_reason: Required content is now on the SO-02 branch, but default main still routes cold starts to stale v010, the complete v003 body is absent and the global pointer remains reconciliation-pending.
controls.next_control: Use a later independently accepted pointer-integration branch to install a default CURRENT pointer and complete controlling source bodies without silently overwriting protected main state.

controls.failure: Carrying PO-01 active and unaccepted into another day without a stop or deadline
controls.uncontrolled_reason: Read-only evidence supports stop-now, but stopping the provider run is a founder-authenticated UI action and no stop receipt exists.
controls.next_control: Founder stops at immutable head 96adfe7 and returns provider terminal state; no new producer file.

controls.failure: Listing independent evaluation as future work instead of operating it
controls.fail_closed_mechanism: A distinct evaluator executed PO-02 interruption replay, PO-03 recovery tests and artifact-level dispositions, and two persistent ChatGPT evaluation lanes now own follow-on work.
